title: Parallel execution
rules: Use next as the sole immediate coordinator continuation.
Dispatch exactly the returned workers and invoke each returned record_finish_packet once with that worker's evidence.
Do not invent merge or cleanup actions; invoke them only when a later packet returns them through next.

sections.heading: Loop
sections.body: Invoke the returned `next` call once. When setup returns workers, fan them out through the selected dispatch adapters and invoke each worker's `data.workers[].dispatch.record_finish_packet` once. Resume only from the `next` returned after those callbacks; later merge and cleanup operations remain packet-owned.

sections.heading: Evidence
sections.body: Record each worker's commit, changed files, tests, coverage, summary, and blockers. A failed or conflicting worker remains packet-owned and blocks unsafe merge or cleanup.

claude.dispatch: Use the returned Claude dispatch adapter once per worker.

codex.dispatch: Use the returned Codex multi-agent dispatch once per worker.

copilot.dispatch: Use the returned Copilot worker dispatch once per worker.

antigravity.dispatch: Use the returned Antigravity subagent dispatch once per worker.
